name: The Holy War
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of war as part of the human experience, describing times of conflict alongside times of peace (Ecclesiastes 3:8) and warning believers not to fear overwhelming enemies because God is with them (Deuteronomy 20:1). While Jesus teaches the blessing of peacemakers and instructs His followers to put away the sword (Matthew 5:9; 26:52), prophetic vision points forward to a future when nations will cease war altogether (Isaiah 2:4). Meanwhile, believers are reminded to remain steadfast amid wars and rumors of wars, recognizing these as signs that the end has not yet come (Matthew 24:6).
